verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability is a SaaS/self-hosted data platform with AI features (natural-language interaction, AI SRE), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training opt-out, data-use policy, or any control preventing customer data from training AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
